AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Cercanías Copilot provides a habitual-journey arrival query and a minimal authorized commitment evaluation. Journey queries require their own explicit opt-in in the app. Commitment evaluations require a separate opaque reference issued only from the app UI for one selected occurrence; it expires within 30 minutes or at its start and can be revoked. Journey opt-in does not grant calendar disclosure, and a valid evaluation reference does not expose journey names. Only Android-authorized consumers can execute these functions. Reference uses user-entered duration and demos retain fixed data and clocks; neither is an operational forecast. Railway alerts never produce delay minutes. Evaluation compares station arrival to meeting start with zero extra margin and zero station-to-meeting travel. No agenda listing, titles, notes, contacts, reference issuance, messaging, ticketing or route changes are exposed.
